sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Mail-Order Retail with Cash on Delivery Settlement

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national unitary jurisdiction; single RCS and tax system for SARL)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Codification) with EU-harmonised commercial, AML/CFT and data-protection overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–Democratic Republic of the Congo Agreement on the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (signed 1999)
France–Democratic Republic of the Congo Double Taxation Avoidance Convention on income and capital taxes
EU–Democratic Republic of the Congo Economic Partnership Agreement (trade and customs facilitation)
Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961 (in force for DRC since 11 October 2017; mutual legalisation path with France)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 through L.561-50 and R.561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), including Article L.561-2-2 (definition of beneficial owner); UBO register regime established by Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016 and Décret n° 2017-1094 du 12 juin 2017; transposition of Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843 through Ordonnance n° 2020-1544 du 9 décembre 2020; SARL-specific obligations of Articles L.223-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code; reporting to the French FIU (TRACFIN) under Article L.561-15 CMF; EU Transfer of Funds and Travel Rule Regulation (EU) 2023/1113.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each UBO's valid passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: DRC Direction Générale de Migration or national civil registry; alternatively French consular authority for DRC nationals resident in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs plus sworn French translation by a court-certified translator; consular legalisation only as fallback if the issuing office is outside the Apostille Convention scope

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record (extrait de casier judiciaire) for each UBO and proposed SARL manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: DRC Parquet de la République (Public Prosecutor's Office) or French Casier Judiciaire National for French residents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs and sworn French translation; French-issued certificates are accepted as certified copies without apostille for domestic filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised power of attorney for the French incorporation signatory (avocat or domiciliation agent) when any UBO acts remotely
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: DRC notary public (Notaire de la République Démocratique du Congo)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs, legalised French translation, and identity verification at the French notary or counsel's office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds / source-of-wealth declaration for the initial capital contribution and COD working capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBO's licensed bank or financial institution, including Airwallex counterparty documentation where applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the issuing institution is located in a Convention state) or consular legalisation otherwise; certified English and French translation for the AML file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of each UBO's residential address (utility bill or residential lease, maximum 3 months old)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local utility provider, landlord or licensed agent in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Sworn translation certified by a French court-approved translator and internal company verification; apostille required only where a French notary executes a deed involving such UBO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding and ongoing daily screening of all UBOs, directors, authorised signatories, freight and local remittance counterparties against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list under Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 and applicable CFSP decisions; (iii) French national asset-freezing measures (gels des avoirs) administered by the Direction générale du Trésor; (iv) the OFAC SDN List as a best-practice benchmark for Airwallex and USD-clearing correspondents; and (v) Interpol Red Notices. Because the Democratic Republic of the Congo is a FATF increased-monitoring jurisdiction, enhanced due diligence is mandatory: verified source-of-funds evidence, senior-management approval for any DRC public official identified as a PEP under Article L.561-10 CMF, and enhanced ongoing monitoring of all cash-on-delivery remittance flows entering the SARL account.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI with the network of Greffes des Tribunaux de Commerce; name availability verification via infogreffe.fr, data.inpi.fr and the EU e-Justice Business Registers interconnection.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory corporate documents and the registered denomination must be in French (Article 2 of the French Constitution and Loi n° 94-665 du 4 août 1994 relative à l'emploi de la langue française). The name must be written in Latin script, must not be contrary to public order or good morals, and must include the type form 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée'. A foreign-language brand must be transliterated into Latin script and filed with a French-language equivalent if it will be marketed to French or OHADA customers; the DRC-facing brand should additionally be cleared against the OHADA/RCCM register because both France and DRC operate in French.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not grant a formal statutory extension of a name-clearance reservation; the 30-day window is the conservative re-validation benchmark used for the simultaneous DRC/OHADA clearance cycle. On refusal by the Greffier or the Guichet Unique, the applicant may first file an informal rectification or amendment request through the same portal within 30 days of notification. A formal refusal of registration is contestable before the juge commis à la surveillance du registre du tribunal de commerce within 10 days of notification (Article L.123-5-4 of the French Commercial Code). Where the refusal arises from an INPI trademark decision, appeal lies to the competent cour d'appel within 2 months under Article R.411-19 of the French Intellectual Property Code; third-party trademark oppositions must be filed within 2 months of publication (Article L.712-4 CPI). If the DRC parallel clearance fails at the OHADA/RCCM level, the applicant must follow the DRC Commercial Court procedure before raising capital or executing franchising or logistics agreements in the DRC.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. Under Article L.123-11-2 of the French Commercial Code, a newly formed SARL may be domiciled at an approved commercial domiciliation company, subject to a maximum term of five years, after which a genuine operational address must be established. Given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML classification of the ISIC 4791 cash-on-delivery model, the SARL should pair the domiciliation address with verifiable management, order-processing or logistics back-office functions in France to evidence commercial substance for French tax, RCS and AML/CFT supervisory purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% annualised probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the domiciliation provider, the Greffier, the DGFiP tax authorities, or an ACPR-linked AML control; the probability is materially elevated while the SARL maintains DRC-related high-risk alerts, cash-intensive remittance rails and a UBO base in a FATF increased-monitoring jurisdiction.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for SARL incorporation dossier and RCS registration submitted through the INPI Guichet Unique, including registry rights (frais de greffe) and mandatory declaration of compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed statutory tariff of the French registry (droits de greffe and official schedule applicable to paperless filings)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of the incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in an authorised legal announcements gazette (journal d'annonces légales) competent for the registered office department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Open market tariff among authorised JAL publishers; statutory minimum content required by the Commercial Code for SARL constitution notices

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and notarisation of the French Articles of Association (statuts), shareholder resolutions, signature-minutes and certified French-English translation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French avocat / expert-comptable and, where required, notaire with certified translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border SARL incorporation (EUR 800 to EUR 2,500 depending on in-kind contributions and number of UBO interventions)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration filing (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) submitted together with the RCS registration bundle, covering the identified beneficial owners above the 25% threshold
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI/Guichet Unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed tariff for the beneficial-owner declaration (EUR 23.40 droit fixe per filing plus service fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial domiciliation (registered office) at an approved French domiciliation company for the first 12 months, including mail forwarding and legal process reception
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of EUR 100 to EUR 250 per month for a medium-risk e-commerce SARL

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legalisation and apostille bundle for DRC-issued shareholder KYC documents (passports, criminal records, notarised powers of attorney), including sworn French translations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs (apostille), French consular section in Kinshasa and French court-certified translators
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff plus prevailing market rate of EUR 80 to EUR 150 per sworn translation per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT enhanced due diligence implementation for Airwallex onboarding and DRC local logistics remittance rails, including PEP/sanctions screening tooling and source-of-funds review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance service providers and Airwallex risk and compliance team
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a medium-risk enhanced due diligence package in an EU cross-border e-commerce onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name and trademark clearance at INPI data, Infogreffe RCS registers and OHADA/RCCM in DRC, including French IP counsel opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, OHADA/RCCM registries and independent French IP counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: comprehensive search and legal opinion EUR 250 to EUR 400; official registry search fees minimal

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L223-1 to L223-43 and R223-1 to R223-36; Civil Code provisions on contracts and contributions; French Monetary and Financial Code provisions on beneficial-owner identification and anti-money-laundering compliance.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI), with registration in the Registre National des Entreprises and the applicable Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés maintained by the competent commercial court registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of company formation submitted through the Guichet unique, including the société à responsabilité limitée formation declaration, articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and supporting documents. The former paper M0 form is generally replaced by the electronic filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital is prescribed for a SARL; the nominal capital may be set at EUR 1 or a higher amount. At least 20% of cash contributions must be paid upon incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Funds are deposited with an authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts before registration, and the deposit certificate is filed. The deposit account is normally blocked until registration and release of the funds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders resolve that the Company shall adopt the articles of association dated [date], with registered office at [address], and share capital of EUR [amount], divided into [number] shares of EUR [nominal value] each. The shareholders approve the subscription and payment of the initial cash contributions and authorize filing with the Guichet unique and the competent commercial court registry. [Name] is appointed as gérant for an indefinite term, subject to the articles and applicable law. [Name] is appointed as deputy or authorized signatory, if applicable. The gérant is authorized to complete all incorporation formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm corporate structure, trade name, and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique; competent commercial court registry for the proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select the SARL form, verify the proposed name through the INPI and trademark databases, secure a qualifying registered office in France, and obtain a domicile certificate or commercial lease. Confirm that the business description covers distance selling, e-commerce, cash-on-delivery collection, logistics coordination, and ancillary services.
required_dossiers: Identification documents for shareholders and gérant
Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace or qualify the company name, correct the activity description, or provide additional address evidence before submission. If the registry rejects the filing, resubmit the corrected electronic application or challenge the refusal before the competent court in accordance with applicable procedural deadlines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare, execute, and publish the articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private execution followed by an authorized Journal d'annonces légales publisher
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles in French, stating the corporate name, form, purpose, registered office, duration, capital, share allocation, management powers, transfer restrictions, and financial-year rules. Have all shareholders sign the articles. Arrange publication of the mandatory formation notice in a legally authorized journal in the department of the registered office and retain the publication certificate.
required_dossiers: Translation or legalization documents where required for foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct defective clauses, signatures, translations, or publication wording and obtain a corrected notice or certificate. Re-execute the articles if a material defect affects validity or registry acceptance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the capital deposit account and obtain the certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized French bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed draft articles, identification and anti-money-laundering documents, beneficial-owner information, shareholder subscription details, and source-of-funds evidence. Deposit at least 20% of subscribed cash capital and obtain the certificate of deposit. Non-cash contributions require valuation and, where applicable, a commissaire aux apports report.
required_dossiers: Commissaire aux apports report, if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank or notary compliance queries with certified identity, ownership, source-of-funds, and business-purpose evidence. Substitute an authorized depositary if the institution declines onboarding, without changing the statutory capital rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the incorporation application through the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic company-formation filing, upload the signed articles, registered-office evidence, publication certificate, capital-deposit certificate, management declarations, identification documents, and beneficial-owner declaration. Pay the applicable filing charges and electronically sign the filing. Ensure the declared activity, tax options, VAT position, and foreign ownership information are internally consistent.
required_dossiers: Gérant acceptance and declaration of non-conviction
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Monitor the electronic dashboard and answer registry queries within the specified period. Upload corrected documents through the portal, pay any supplemental fee, and obtain a new filing receipt. A refusal may be contested or resubmitted after curing the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration evidence and activate post-incorporation compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent commercial court registry, INPI, French tax administration, and URSSAF
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the registration extract, normally the Kbis or equivalent registry evidence, and confirm the SIREN, SIRET, APE code, registered office, gérant, and beneficial-owner status. Activate the bank account, release deposited capital, register for applicable tax accounts, arrange accounting records, and complete employer registrations before hiring personnel.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction of inaccurate registry data through the Guichet unique or registry. File amended articles or management changes when required and maintain evidence of all tax, accounting, payroll, and beneficial-owner filings.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sector-specific industrial licensing board is ordinarily required for ordinary mail-order or e-commerce retail. Where premises trigger environmental or classified-installation rules, the competent authorities are the prefecture and the regional environment, planning, and housing directorate (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement, DREAL).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general manufacturing or retail operating permit is required for ordinary online retail with cash-on-delivery settlement. A commercial lease, local planning compliance, consumer-law compliance, and any applicable warehouse, transport, alcohol, food, or product-specific authorization remain separately assessable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, through the relevant prefecture and Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from project-level EIA for ordinary office and small-scale e-commerce premises, unless the project falls within an EIA category or the warehouse qualifies as an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE). Large storage facilities may require an ICPE declaration, registration, or authorization depending on stored products, quantities, fire load, and thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No sector-specific wastewater or VOC threshold applies to ordinary office-based online retail beyond general public-health, waste, sewer, and environmental rules. Warehouses and classified installations must comply with the applicable ICPE order, authorized discharge limits, hazardous-waste traceability, spill prevention, fire-water containment, and waste-transfer documentation. Hazardous substances require appropriate storage, labeling, and contractor documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain premises-specific fire-safety compliance under the French building and workplace rules. An establishment open to the public may require an ERP safety and accessibility review by the municipal authority and, where applicable, the departmental fire and rescue service. Industrial or warehouse premises must maintain fire detection or suppression systems, emergency exits, electrical conformity, evacuation procedures, and periodic inspections. Employers must prepare a risk assessment document, the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels, and complete occupational-health arrangements before employing staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des finances publiques (DGFiP), administered through the competent Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) or the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères for non-established businesses. The principal digital portal is impots.gouv.fr, including the professional tax account and VAT registration procedures. Company formation and business registration data are generally submitted through the Guichet unique operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), which issues the SIREN and SIRET identifiers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is registered through the Guichet unique before commencing business. The filing generally includes the articles of association, registered-office evidence, beneficial-owner information, identification of managers and shareholders, activity description, and registration declarations. The competent registry transmits the information to the DGFiP, which establishes the entity's tax account. The SARL receives or uses its SIREN identifier for tax administration and, where liable to VAT, obtains a French VAT identification number in the format FR plus a two-digit control key and the nine-digit SIREN. A foreign entity without a French establishment that must register for French VAT applies to the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères and submits corporate, identity, activity, French-taxable-transaction, bank-account, and representative documentation as requested. A non-EU business may require a French tax representative unless an applicable legal or treaty exemption applies. VAT registration is required when the entity makes transactions taxable in France, subject to applicable exemption, reverse-charge, import, distance-selling, and One Stop Shop rules; the domestic small-business franchise threshold is not generally available to non-established businesses for French transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is generally subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). Eligible SARLs formed for a limited period and satisfying statutory ownership, size, activity, and age conditions may elect taxation under the partnership regime, under which profits are attributed to the partners and taxed at partner level; the election is generally limited to five fiscal years. A family SARL meeting the statutory family-ownership and activity conditions may elect the family partnership regime without the ordinary five-year limitation, subject to continuing eligibility. The election is made with the relevant tax service and is not a general United States-style check-the-box election. France also applies anti-hybrid-mismatch rules implementing EU requirements, which can deny deductions, require inclusion, or restrict exemption where arrangements produce deduction/non-inclusion or double-deduction outcomes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA), supplemented by customs duties and import VAT. French VAT applies according to the place-of-supply rules, including domestic supplies, imports, intra-Community transactions, distance sales, digital services, and reverse-charge mechanisms.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For French-established businesses eligible for the domestic VAT franchise, the principal turnover thresholds are generally EUR 85,000 for supplies of goods, sales for consumption on premises, and accommodation, with an increased threshold of EUR 93,500, and EUR 37,500 for services and non-commercial activities, with an increased threshold of EUR 41,250. Thresholds are subject to statutory adjustments and activity-specific rules. A non-established business generally cannot rely on the French domestic franchise threshold for French-taxable transactions and may require registration from the first relevant transaction. Mandatory registration can also arise independently of turnover, including for imports, certain intra-Community transactions, distance sales, transfers of own goods, and transactions subject to reverse charge or special schemes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France does not currently operate a universal real-time VAT invoice-clearance system for ordinary domestic transactions. The statutory electronic-invoicing reform requires all French-established businesses to be able to receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026. Issuance obligations are scheduled from 1 September 2026 for large and intermediate-sized enterprises and from 1 September 2027 for small and medium-sized enterprises and micro-enterprises, subject to legislative or regulatory amendments. Invoices must generally pass through an approved private platform or the public invoicing portal framework. Electronic reporting of certain B2C and international transactions is also being phased in. Invoices must contain mandatory French VAT particulars, including supplier and customer identification, VAT numbers where required, sequential numbering, date, taxable amount, VAT rate and amount, exemptions or reverse-charge wording, and applicable transport or customs references. Electronic signatures, structured formats, data retention, and audit-trail requirements may apply; there is no general French requirement for a digital tax stamp on every invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from France to a destination outside the European Union may be invoiced without French VAT where the supplier establishes that the goods left the EU customs territory and satisfies the documentary and timing requirements. Evidence normally includes the export customs declaration, exit confirmation, transport documentation, commercial invoice, and a consistent audit trail linking the sale to the shipment. Intra-Community supplies of goods may qualify for exemption rather than export zero-rating when the customer is VAT-registered in another EU Member State, the goods are dispatched to that Member State, and the supplier holds the required customer VAT number and transport evidence. Services supplied to a business established outside France may be outside the scope of French VAT under the B2B place-of-supply rule rather than technically zero-rated; the supplier must retain evidence of the customer's business status and establishment. Separate rules apply to B2C services, intermediary services, digital services, immovable-property services, passenger transport, and services effectively used and enjoyed in France. Input VAT refunds require valid invoices, import documents, and evidence that the input VAT relates to taxable or qualifying exempt activities. Refunds may be denied where export evidence, customer status, customs exit, or transaction substance is inadequate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration containing the applicable export procedure and accurate exporter, consignee, commodity, value, and origin information
Electronic customs exit confirmation or equivalent customs evidence, such as an exit results message or certified alternative proof accepted by French customs
Commercial invoice and order or contract documentation identifying the goods, customer, price, VAT treatment, and shipment
Transport evidence, including bill of lading, air waybill, CMR consignment note, courier record, or carrier delivery and exit confirmation
Packing list and, where relevant, export licences, certificates of origin, sanctions documentation, and product-specific regulatory documents
Proof of payment or other commercial settlement evidence where relevant to establish transaction reality
For intra-Community supplies, the customer's valid EU VAT identification number, dispatch evidence, and required recapitulative statement data

An inward remittance certificate is not a standard mandatory French export-VAT document; payment evidence may nevertheless be requested during an audit, particularly for non-routine or high-risk transactions
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France does not impose a general statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline of 180 days for export proceeds. Export VAT exemption or refund may be retrospectively denied where the taxpayer cannot prove export, EU exit, customer status, transaction substance, or correct reporting. The unpaid VAT may be assessed with late-payment interest, generally calculated at 0.20% per month subject to applicable statutory rules, and tax penalties. Deliberate or abusive conduct may attract a 40% penalty for deliberate failure, an 80% penalty for fraudulent manoeuvres or abuse of rights, or other applicable surcharges; failure to produce records or serious accounting deficiencies can trigger additional penalties. Incorrect invoices, false customs evidence, fictitious exports, or fraudulent VAT refund claims may create criminal tax-fraud exposure, customs penalties, repayment of improperly refunded VAT, joint liability in certain circumstances, and restriction or withdrawal of VAT refund claims. Interest and penalties are assessed under the French Tax Procedure Code and may be challenged through the applicable administrative and judicial remedies.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), with monetary policy competence exercised through the European Central Bank and foreign-exchange policy coordination through the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty (DG Trésor).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible on both current and capital account under Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement and the EU Treaty freedoms. France maintains no exchange-control restrictions on inward or outward capital flows, trade settlements, or dividend remittances for registered commercial entities. A French SARL may remit distributable profits abroad after annual accounts approval; however, dividends paid to non-EU resident shareholders are subject to a 30% statutory withholding tax unless a lower treaty rate applies, and the paying bank and French tax authority require documentary evidence of tax residence and beneficial ownership. Current-account payments such as supplier invoices are unrestricted. Statistical reporting under the French Monetary and Financial Code applies to cross-border transactions above the Banque de France filing threshold.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Eurozone and French exchange-control rules impose no mandatory surrender period, forced conversion ratio, repatriation deadline, or conversion benchmark for export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained in EUR or in a foreign currency, provided the transaction is reflected in the books and, when relevant, reported to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics. No statutory conversion ratio applies to cash-on-delivery collections from emerging markets, but all collections must be routed through licensed banking or payment-institution channels and reconciled against underlying trade documentation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High viability with strict legal conditions. A French SARL may use an EU-authorised Electronic Money Institution or Payment Institution under PSD2 as an operational account provider, provided the EMI holds a French ACPR licence or a valid passport from another EU/EEA regulator. Offshore, non-EU digital EMIs are not lawful substitutes for a French or EU-licensed account, and their collection services may expose the SARL to unlicensed-payment-activity risk and banking de-risking. Airwallex, through its authorised EU entity, is a workable cross-border treasury rail for FX conversion and disbursements, but the SARL should maintain at least one French domestic bank account for statutory, tax, and court payment needs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML/KYC law under Articles L.561-1 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code does not mandate a physical interview solely on legal grounds, although the obliged entity must perform full customer due diligence and verify the identity of the manager and every beneficial owner. In practice, most tier-1 French banks require either a physical branch meeting or a high-grade videoconference interview with the gérant and beneficial owners; non-resident directors may be asked to attend in person or to submit an apostilled corporate pack, certified passports, proof of residential address, tax residence certificates, and source-of-funds/wealth evidence. Remote opening is possible but materially slower and typically subject to compliance approval and enhanced monitoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-on-delivery e-commerce is classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced because of high transaction velocity, small-value cash flows, and geographically dispersed counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A formal AML/CFT compliance charter, customer KYC and transaction-monitoring policy, cash-handling manual, logistics partner contracts, reconciliation procedures, flow diagrams showing COD collections from local logistics agents, and a 12-month expected treasury profile mapping each cash source to the French bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners and cross-border payment chains routed through emerging-market logistics remittance agents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passports, proof of address, tax residence certificates, French company extract (extrait Kbis), signed and registered by-laws, an updated beneficial-ownership register, a full corporate org chart, shareholder source-of-wealth letters, notarised board resolutions, and written commercial agreements with every logistics remittance partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital contributions from third countries or jurisdictions with perceived sanctions or source-of-funds opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of sending-entity bank statements, audited financial statements of the shareholder, an ownership register, share subscription and contribution agreements, share-premium calculations, blocked-funds certificate from the receiving bank, SWIFT reference records, sanctions and adverse-media screening reports, and a notarised source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-speed treasury movements between the French operating account and overseas logistics suppliers, potentially resembling money passing or trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented treasury policy, daily cash reconciliation ledger, settlement calendar, matched supplier invoices and proof-of-delivery files, signed logistics agreements, periodic customer refund reports, a comprehensive transaction narrative aligned to ISIC 4791, and evidence that each outgoing SWIFT MT103 traces to an underlying commercial obligation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Execute shareholder capital injections by direct SWIFT MT103 from the sending entity to the SARL's EUR IBAN. If funds arrive in USD, instruct the paying bank or a correspondent bank to convert immediately to EUR with an explicit FX conversion instruction and disclose the purpose as 'capital increase / share premium / capital contribution'. For French balance-of-payments reporting, use the Banque de France 'motif monétaire' category applicable to non-resident direct investment or capital movements when the bank requires it. The SARL must retain the capital contribution certificate, bank blocked-funds certificate, registry-filed by-laws or amendment, and proof of the completed legal formalities; these documents serve as both KYC evidence and treasury verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for individual supplier and logistics payments and MT101 for batch payment instructions, with each payment referencing the underlying commercial invoice and, where applicable, the contract, proforma invoice, shipping documents, and proof-of-delivery records. For high-value strategic or sensitive settlements, use a commercial documentary letter of credit under UCP 600 issued or confirmed by a French bank. All outbound payments above the Banque de France reporting threshold must be captured in the bank's balance-of-payments reporting. For local logistics and last-mile cash collection in the emerging market, use only licensed PSP corridors or banks approved by the SARL's French bank; no crypto-based settlement or unlicensed cash courier is permissible.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable FX forwards with a licensed French credit institution or EU investment firm under ISDA or French-law confirmations
EUR/CNY and EUR/USD rolling or periodic forwards aligned with commercial settlement cycles
Non-deliverable forwards on emerging-market currencies where physical delivery is legally restricted or unavailable
Cross-currency swaps for matched capital injections and long-dated trade payables
FX spot transactions for immediate conversion of collected foreign currency
FX options and zero-cost collars, subject to ACPR/EU MiFID suitability and adequate internal hedging policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements and shareholders' meeting minutes (dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Guichet Unique (Commercial Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit with registry within 1 month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine up to €1,500 (€3,000 for legal entity); possible court injunction; administrative strike-off for failure to file for 2 consecutive years

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and financial statement declarations (liasse fiscale n°2065)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers: by the second working day after 1 May; for non-calendar fiscal year: within 3 months and 15 days after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty 5% of tax assessed; late payment penalty 10% on balance due; monthly interest 0.20%; increased to 40% for intentional omission or fraud

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration update (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in controlling ownership or beneficial ownership; no separate annual filing but accuracy must be confirmed at each annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Director liable to €20,000 fine and up to 6 months imprisonment; late filing also incurs registry penalties and may block future filings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if it exceeds two of three thresholds: balance sheet total > €450,000, net turnover > €900,000, average number of employees > 11; also required for controlling parent companies or when 1/3 of shareholders or specific 10% shareholders demand it
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (ANCC reglements, Code de Commerce, Articles L123-12 to L123-28); IFRS mandatory for consolidated listed groups and optional under certain conditions

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation is embedded in the annual accounts deposit; the gérant signs a sworn statement that the beneficial owner register is accurate and up to date; any share transfer or ownership change requires an updated beneficial owner declaration within 30 days; the register of members must be updated immediately upon transfer
